name: Raffles Institution
summary: Premier local boys’ independent school — IP and high-stakes academic culture.
body: RI is a landmark local independent school. Expat families rarely enter via typical international admissions; eligibility, citizenship, and MOE pathways dominate. Included here so relocating parents understand the local top-tier landscape when comparing options for PR/citizen children. Confirm orientation / reporting timelines and parent-portal alert settings before term start — dual-career families need calendar-ready notices, not day-of WhatsApp surprises. Service calendars run hard beside illness weeks — keep written UTI return clocks separate from evening hall call times.
waitlistNotes: Not an international open-enrolment school — MOE rules apply.
